scenes.title_cn: 开场：化结构 vs 化五官
scenes.title_en: Opening: Sculpt the Face vs. Paint the Features
scenes.context: 同样的淡妆，化五官重色彩只会扁平土气；化结构重轮廓才能立体精致。今天要学的是古象贵气感淡妆，做到真正的「淡妆不淡人」。语域：美妆教学，先抛结论。
sentences: 化五官、重色彩，扁平土气。
Just painting the features and loading on color leaves your face flat and plain.
flat and plain（扁平土气）
化结构、重轮廓，立体精致。
Sculpting the structure and defining the contours looks dimensional and refined.
dimensional（立体的）；refined（精致）
做到真正的淡妆不淡人。
Achieve a look that's light on makeup but not light on presence.
light on makeup（淡妆）；not light on presence（不淡人）
paraphrase: 扁平土气 → flat and plain / dull and flat
flat · plain
立体精致 → dimensional and refined / sculpted and polished
dimensional · refined
scenes.speak: Just painting the features and loading on color leaves your face flat and plain. Sculpting the structure and defining the contours looks dimensional and refined. Achieve a look that's light on makeup but not light on presence.

scenes.title_en: Base Makeup: Foundation Only on the Inner Face
scenes.context: 大屏脸和小V脸的区别就在于上粉底液的距离。整脸铺满显脸大，只上在内轮廓脸立马小一圈。所以粉底液不需要太多，用刷子薄薄蘸取一层。语域：美妆教学，步骤讲解。
sentences: 大屏脸和小V脸的区别，就在于上粉底液的距离。
The difference between a round face and a V-shaped face comes down to where you apply the foundation.
come down to（归结于）；apply the foundation（上粉底液）
整脸铺满就是显脸大。
Covering the whole face with foundation just makes it look bigger.
cover the whole face（整脸铺满）
粉底液不需要太多，用刷子薄薄蘸取一层。
You don't need much foundation — just dip the brush in a thin layer.
a thin layer（薄薄一层）
paraphrase: 归结于 → come down to / boil down to
come down to · boil down to
薄薄一层 → a thin layer / a light coat
thin layer · light coat
scenes.speak: The difference between a round face and a V-shaped face comes down to where you apply the foundation. Covering the whole face with foundation just makes it look bigger. You don't need much foundation — just dip the brush in a thin layer.

scenes.title_en: Finding the Inner-Face Line: A Profile Trick
scenes.context: 把脸侧过来，侧到只能看到眉峰最高点，沿这个点上下各画一条线再回正，就是内轮廓线。粉底液不能超过这条线，从内往外铺，保证T区粉量更多、遮瑕力更高，越往外粉量越少。语域：美妆教学，定位讲解。
sentences: 把脸侧过来，侧到只能看到眉峰最高点的位置。
Turn your face to the side until you can only see the highest point of your brow.
the highest point of your brow（眉峰最高点）
这条就是我们的内轮廓线了。
This line is our inner-face contour line.
inner-face contour line（内轮廓线）
粉底从内往外铺，保证T区粉量更多，遮瑕力更高。
Spread the foundation from the inside out, keeping more product on the T-zone for higher coverage.
the T-zone（T区）；higher coverage（更高遮瑕）
paraphrase: 眉峰最高点 → the highest point of your brow / the peak of your brow arch
brow peak · brow arch
从内往外 → from the inside out / working outward
from inside out · outward
scenes.speak: Turn your face to the side until you can only see the highest point of your brow. This line is our inner-face contour line. Spread the foundation from the inside out, keeping more product on the T-zone for higher coverage.

scenes.title_en: Four Contour Strokes: The Head-Wraps-Face Effect
scenes.context: 想要头包脸、五官立体，就要加强面部明暗对比度。头包脸只需四笔修容：一连接额角与眉峰，二连接眼尾与眉尾，三侧面颧骨最高点到发际线，四嘴角垂直到耳垂，然后往外晕开。语域：美妆教学，口诀式教学。
sentences: 想要达到头包脸、五官立体的效果，就要加强面部明暗对比度。
For that head-wraps-face, sculpted look, you need to boost the light-shadow contrast on your face.
light-shadow contrast（明暗对比度）
头包脸只需要四笔修容。
The head-wraps-face effect only takes four contour strokes.
contour strokes（修容笔画）
第一笔连接额角与眉峰。
Stroke one connects the corner of your forehead to your brow arch.
the corner of your forehead（额角）
paraphrase: 明暗对比 → light-shadow contrast / contrast between light and shade
light-shadow contrast · chiaroscuro
四笔修容 → four contour strokes / four sweeps of contour
four strokes · four sweeps
scenes.speak: For that head-wraps-face, sculpted look, you need to boost the light-shadow contrast on your face. The head-wraps-face effect only takes four contour strokes. Stroke one connects the corner of your forehead to your brow arch.

scenes.title_cn: 立体五官：双C与体量提亮
scenes.context: 山根的双C线从眼头开始顺着眼眶骨画，鼻头画U可抬高鼻尖缩小鼻头，双C向两头晕染、鼻头向外晕染，让侧面阴影自然衔接。之后加上体量：额头、鼻梁、鼻头、下巴的中轴线，眼下泪沟法令纹，颧骨位置向内移提升面部折叠度。语域：美妆教学，点位讲解。
sentences: 山根的双C线要从眼头开始，顺着眼眶骨画。
The double-C lines on the nose bridge start from the inner corners of your eyes, following the eye socket.
the double-C lines（双C线）；eye socket（眼眶骨）
鼻头画U，可以抬高鼻尖、缩小鼻头。
Drawing a U on the nose tip lifts it and makes it look smaller.
nose tip（鼻尖）
让面部折叠度更高。
Make the face fold more deeply for a sharper structure.
face fold（面部折叠度）；sharper structure（更立体的结构）
paraphrase: 顺着眼眶骨 → following the eye socket / tracing the orbital bone
eye socket · orbital bone
面部折叠度 → face fold / facial depth
face fold · facial depth
scenes.speak: The double-C lines on the nose bridge start from the inner corners of your eyes, following the eye socket. Drawing a U on the nose tip lifts it and makes it look smaller. Make the face fold more deeply for a sharper structure.

scenes.title_en: Brows: Lighten Them for Softness and Hair Texture
scenes.context: 化妆新手很容易把眉毛颜色画深，浓眉和淡妆很不协调。先用螺旋梳把眉毛刷顺，再用染眉膏染浅，浅眉让整个人更柔和；然后用硬芯眉笔画毛流填补空隙，眉头向上、眉中斜画、眉尾倒着画。语域：美妆教学，对比讲解。
sentences: 一个淡妆跟一个浓眉就很不协调。
A light makeup look paired with dark heavy brows just doesn't fit together.
dark heavy brows（浓眉）；doesn't fit（不协调）
浅眉会让整个人看上去更柔和。
Lighter brows make your whole face look softer.
lighter brows（浅眉）；look softer（更柔和）
眉头向上画，眉中斜着画，眉尾倒着画。
Brush the inner brow upward, the middle at an angle, and the tail back against the grain.
the inner brow（眉头）；at an angle（斜着）；against the grain（倒着）
paraphrase: 不协调 → doesn't fit / clashes with
doesn't fit · clashes
倒着画 → against the grain / in the opposite direction
against the grain · opposite direction
scenes.speak: A light makeup look paired with dark heavy brows just doesn't fit together. Lighter brows make your whole face look softer. Brush the inner brow upward, the middle at an angle, and the tail back against the grain.

scenes.title_cn: 眼妆：收缩色扩大眼影+卧蚕
scenes.title_en: Eye Look: Shrink Colors and the Under-Eye Bag
scenes.context: 想放大眼睛，不需要太多眼影叠加，只需找到收缩色腮红，把眼影范围预染大但不超眼眶骨，可包到眼头并稍往下。再用窄刷蘸哑光高光提亮，找到瞳孔正下方左右扫出卧蚕宽度，还可用修容混一点腮红加深卧蚕线，先提亮再加深适合新手。语域：美妆教学，技巧讲解。
sentences: 想要放大眼睛，其实不需要太多的眼影叠加。
To make your eyes look bigger, you don't need to layer on a lot of eyeshadow.
layer on（叠加）
只需要找到一个收缩色的腮红。
You just need a shrink-tone blush.
shrink-tone blush（收缩色腮红）
这种先提亮后加深的方法，就很适合新手。
This brighten-first, deepen-second method is perfect for beginners.
brighten-first（先提亮）；deepen-second（后加深）
paraphrase: 收缩色 → shrink-tone / a receding shade
shrink-tone · receding shade
先提亮后加深 → brighten-first, deepen-second / highlight then contour
brighten then deepen · highlight then contour
scenes.speak: To make your eyes look bigger, you don't need to layer on a lot of eyeshadow. You just need a shrink-tone blush. This brighten-first, deepen-second method is perfect for beginners.

scenes.title_cn: 眼线睫毛+腮红口红收尾
scenes.title_en: Liner, Lashes, Blush, and Lips to Finish
scenes.context: 用刀锋刷蘸深色眼影沿眼尾平拉一条线再晕开虚化，最后用眼线液笔加深睫毛根部。夹睫毛边夹边往上抬，刷上睫毛定型保持一整天。腮红用收缩色从颧骨最高点斜向内扫修饰脸型。口红纯线不能太实，颜色与眼影腮红一致，晕染唇峰、唇中、下唇三条线，最后加唇蜜。语域：美妆教学，收尾步骤。
sentences: 用眼线液笔加深睫毛根部。
Use a liquid liner to deepen the lash line.
liquid liner（眼线液笔）；lash line（睫毛根部）
夹的时候一定要边夹边往上抬，这样夹出来的睫毛就是自然卷翘的。
Curl and lift upward as you go, and your lashes will come out naturally curled.
curl and lift（边夹边抬）；naturally curled（自然卷翘）
口红颜色尽量选择跟眼影腮红色调一致的。
Try to pick a lipstick in the same tone as your eyeshadow and blush.
in the same tone（色调一致）
paraphrase: 睫毛根部 → lash line / the roots of your lashes
lash line · lash roots
色调一致 → in the same tone / coordinated shades
same tone · coordinated shades
scenes.speak: Use a liquid liner to deepen the lash line. Curl and lift upward as you go, and your lashes will come out naturally curled. Try to pick a lipstick in the same tone as your eyeshadow and blush.

practice: Achieve a look that's light on makeup but not light on presence.
For that head-wraps-face look, you need to boost the light-shadow contrast.
Lighter brows make your whole face look softer.
This brighten-first, deepen-second method is perfect for beginners.
pitfalls: The makeup makes my face flat and ground.
The makeup leaves my face flat and plain.
扁平用 flat and plain（平淡）而非 ground。
I apply powder to the whole face.
Covering the whole face with foundation just makes it look bigger.
粉底是 foundation，不是 powder（散粉）；「显脸大」用 makes it look bigger。
I draw the eyebrow against the hair.
Brush the inner brow upward and the tail against the grain.
「倒着画」是 against the grain，不是 against the hair。
The blush color is same with eyeshadow.
Pick a lipstick in the same tone as your eyeshadow and blush.
the same tone as（与…同调）才是正确搭配。
shifts: 用 apply foundation only on the inner face（只上内轮廓）、spread from the inside out（从内往外铺）
用 four contour strokes（四笔修容）、boost light-shadow contrast（加强明暗对比）、head-wraps-face（头包脸）
说显脸小只会 look small
用 fold more deeply（更高折叠度）、refined（精致）、dimensional（立体）
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已校正：古象→骨相、大屏脸→大圆脸、眉峰最高点、双C线、山根、泪沟、法令纹、顴骨→颧骨、体量→提亮、卧残→卧蚕、匀染→晕染、纯线→唇线、鱼粉→余粉、染眉膏、螺旋书→螺旋梳、刀锋刷、眼线液笔、唇蜜等。
